svg.aria-label: Nine-frame rough storyboard for Duckhook and ObiWan charity golf, with two clearly conditional endings
svg.text: SCHEMIN ’26 / WEEK 9 / GAME OF THE WEEK

g.text: 01 / P04 — THE MORNING PROMISE
CHARITY
CLASSIC
CCOJ at sunrise. Host and visitor enter a calm world.
Clubhouse left. Water hazard right. No result implied.
02 / P04 — COURTESY WITH AN EDGE
Duckhook offers the scorecard; ObiWan accepts.
The invitation becomes a personal rematch.
03 / P05 — THE HOST’S FIRST STATEMENT
One driver, two hands, complete follow-through.
ObiWan watches outside the swing arc.
04 / P05 — THE VISITOR’S ANSWER
ObiWan rotates through a sand-recovery attempt.
Club, ball and sand read as separate elements.
05 / P05 — THE SMILES DISAPPEAR
NO SCORE SHOWN
A glance and a tightening grip change the relationship.
No fabricated golf score or premature winner.
06 / P06 — SHOW THE RISK FIRST
BALL
FLAG
SLOPED APRON
POND
Ball → flag → sloped apron → pond, in one view.
The audience sees the danger before the shot.
07 / P06 — BEFORE THE STROKE
GRIP / STILL BALL
The grip steadies. The opponent waits. Hold the moment.
PAGE TURN: choose only the verified result branch.
08A / P07 — IF OBIWAN WINS
Duckhook overhits; the established slope feeds the pond.
HYPOTHETICAL ENDING A — not a reported result.
08B / P07 — IF DUCKHOOK WINS
ObiWan’s mishit ends in rough; Duckhook stays composed.
HYPOTHETICAL ENDING B — mutually exclusive with A.
